overview.description: The T. Rowe Price Natural Resource ETF (TURF) is an exchange-traded fund. The fund's investment portfolio concentrates primarily on theme equity. TURF is an actively managed ETF, aiming to outperform its respective sector index TURF was launched on Jun 11, 2025 and is issued by T. Rowe Price.
